title: National Highway Development Programme (NHDP) Phases

timeline
    title NHDP Phases (1998‑2022)
    1998-2003 : Phase I – Golden Quadrilateral, Delhi‑Mumbai Expressway (≈9,000 km)
    2003-2009 : Phase II – North‑South & East‑West Corridors, NH‑7 upgrade (≈12,500 km)
    2009-2015 : Phase III – Four‑lane widening of 30,000 km of NHs (≈30,000 km)
    2015-2022 : Phase IV – First five Bharatmala corridors & 20+ expressways (≈5,000 km ongoing)
description: Chronological timeline summarising the four phases of the National Highway Development Programme, key projects, and cumulative lengths.
